## What's new

- ChaOS Pixel Names draws every console's name at the same size, so moving
  between them changes the word, not the scale.
- The colored glow is now a soft, blurred reflection under the name, in
  the console's colour, fading as it goes down.

---

ChaOS 0.11.1 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.11.1-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.11.1-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
